@2948.en: You can start this stage of the World Mystery by speaking with Selene de Ardeur on Evermeet Isle (Level 4). Once you are done with your task, speak with Hugues de Delice in Novograd to complete it (Level 6).

@3020.en: The mystery of the ancient June ruins has been solved! They can be used to tap into the ancient teleportation network and travel between the strange devices. The Adventurer's Stone now allows its owner to move quickly between neighboring allods. It is a wondrous device, indeed!
